ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the number of cases and the total amount of money involved.
questions: What is the total amount of money involved in Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota?
How many cases of Medicaid fraud have been reported in Minnesota in the past year?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale pattern of fraud in Minnesota's Medicaid program. By analyzing data and public records, we may be able to identify additional cases and connections between entities.
